title: Nobody Rang the Bell (Part 1)
altTitles: Something Lives in the Bell Tower (Part 1)
description: At midnight, the bell rang. Nobody was in the tower. Part 1 of 3. #stickfigure #animation #shorts
topic: S23 F4 micro-drama Part 1/3: the bell tower, the eyes, the fall

sections.label: S1 Hook: the bell rang
sections.videoPrompt: Cinematic 3D animated film. The characters are stylized stick figures: glossy matte-black ink bodies with uniform thin cylindrical limbs, perfectly round glossy black heads with no facial features except two small glowing oval eyes, and a thin emissive rim light in each character's signature color. They are set inside a hyper-detailed, physically lit 3D environment with volumetric light shafts, atmospheric haze, real materials, shallow depth of field and film-grade color grading. BOLT: an average-height black ink stick figure with a round glossy head, electric cyan (#22D3EE) glowing eyes and rim light, a long flowing cyan scarf that trails light when moving. PIP: a short, small black ink stick figure (half BOLT's height) with a round glossy head, amber (#FFB020) glowing eyes and rim light, oversized brass aviator goggles on the forehead, a boxy amber backpack with antennae. BRICK: a large black ink stick figure with thick heavy limbs (three times normal thickness) and a round glossy head, lime green (#7CFF4F) glowing eyes and rim light, a lime visor band across the eyes. Vertical frame. At midnight, a huge bronze bell swings by itself inside an old stone bell tower with no one near it; the camera descends through drifting fog to a village rooftop where Bolt, Pip and Brick sit up and turn toward the tower, their rim lights glowing. Crane down, 24mm, cold blue moonlight, thick fog. Avoid: text, letters, numbers, logos, mouths, noses, teeth, human faces, skin, hair, clothing beyond the listed accessories, extra limbs, fingers except three rounded nubs in close-ups, blood, gore, flat or empty backgrounds.

qc: S23: Drift — Pip is small in Brick's arms (S2). Limbs — carrying poses. Faces — the 'eyes' in the bell are eye-dots only; any creature faces or mouths = reject. Style — fog must not flatten into a grey wash. Seam — the S4-END landing pose (bell falling above them) becomes Part 2's recap keyframe; keep it. Text — none expected. Global gate (brief §0.3): accent hue shift >6 frames / missing accessory / size swap = re-roll; 3rd limb or fused limb ≥3 frames = re-roll; any mouth, nose, teeth, brows, skin or human face even 1 frame = reject; flat/white/empty bg, 2D look, lost rim light or blood = re-roll; stitch seam at 30s: position jump >5% width, lighting flip, prop changing hands, screen-direction reversal = regenerate the later segment; any legible or pseudo-glyph text in a plate = mask or re-roll (all real text is Remotion labels). Check sourceSpec width/height/duration every clip.
